nom: PEACH & LILY Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser

avis.titre: Got it as a birthday gift!
avis.texte: I'm normally not a fan of oil based cleansers, but this one is the sole exception!! It melts my makeup off (Especially my eye makeup! That's the biggest thing i look for) and leaves my skin feeling super clean! I follow up with a CeraVe cleanser afterward to make sure every bit of makeup is removed. I recommend getting the small size if you're trying it out for the first time. :D

Definitely too thick. Doesnt glide/melt off like other makeup oil cleansers. I tried many brands but this def ranks last. Not worth spending your money. I tossed mine out after needing to use my gentle cleanser four times to get rid of the makeup oil first.
It's thicker than I thought it would be. It feels nice, but it doesn't work well. I have to do a third wash to get it all off. I don't recommend
This is the worst cleanser i have ever tried. It doesnt remove any eye makeup even with scrubbing. I dont even use waterproof makeup.

avis.titre: Yes I would buy the ginger melt oil cleanser again!
avis.texte: Peach &Lily ginger melt oil cleanser really got grime off my face! I would recommend this product to everyone.

I really wanted to like this cleansing oil, but it's too thick and hard to wash off. It hasn't irritated my skin, thankfully, but the thickness makes it extremely hard to rinse off before my second cleanse - I often have to do a third cleanse just to get it all off. This is the first P&L product that's disappointed me, and I hope they consider adjusting the viscosity to make it easier to rinse from the skin.

Second time buying this - it lasts me forever and the formula just helps keep my eczema-prone skin feeling moisturized after washing. It's extremely gentle so it isn't my favorite thing to use on days when I wear more makeup, especially waterproof eye makeup. It work best for me as a basic daily cleanser when I'm wearing minimal makeup
This product was a game changer, was breaking out on my chin. started using this, and my breakouts went away. Love the feeling of the oil feels clean.
Thick and soothing. Gentle fragrance.Feels too good to be a cleanser. It is my favorite treatments

avis.titre: Got this as the Birthday Gift Reward
avis.texte: Maybe because its a smaller bday gift version of the product but it did not work for me. I haven't gotten any breakouts thankfully but it barely removed any of the daily makeup I where to work.

i got this as the free bday gift ulta offers. the first few times i used it i thought it was working pretty well until i started noticing small acne spots forming on my face, which led to a full on breakout. i'd successfully prevented any major breakouts for three years, so this was really disappointing. i wouldn't recommend buying this product unless you've used the free version.
This cleanser works real good, simple to use, no fragrance for me, I love it, was recommended by Ulta employees for a cleanser (:

There is a lot of mixed reviews and thats fair everyone skin is different. My skin is sensitive snd my skin had bo issues after the first few uses. Its important to sit there and massage the products into your face then rinsing. Leaves a smooth and baby soft finish to my skin without feeling like it stripped my face but feels very clean! I would even say thisis a great second step rinse if you firdt use a pore cleanser this just gives your skind that final step 'aaaaah' clean and smooth finish. I dont notice it making my skin oily or anything afterward. I am buying the large bottoe after trying the 1 fl. oz. And encourage everyone to do the same and try the small bottle. Small disclaimer you do have to pump a fair amount into your palm and massage it all in as a small amount of product initially wont be enough, so its easy to run through the product if your a daily user.

Got this for my birthday free gift and I love this stuff, does a nice job without drying my skin out. I rub it in gently, leave it to sit for a few seconds then wipe it off with a damp warm washcloth and go about my routine.

Ive loved some of the other Peach & Lily products and decided to try this. Thank goodness I bought the travel size. This does not wash off well at all. After rinsing my face SEVERAL TIMES I then have to wash my face TWICE with the face cleanser. Once to get the remaining oil off my face, second to actually cleanse my skin. This is a waste of face wash having to do this. I will stick with the other brand for face oil that works much better.
Received it as a free gift with the birthday month. Had I paid for it? I would have returned it. I only used it a couple days and noticed my face breaking out immediately so I discontinued use.

avis.titre: Feels like I got a chemical burn from a cleanser
avis.texte: This has to be the worst cleanser ive ever used. I chose this as my birthday reward from ulta because I ran out of my preferred Biossance oil cleanser, but I really wish I'd picked anything else. I didn't have the watery texture I now see others have complained about, but rather it was such a thick oil that it was a struggle to rinse it off. I tried using it to remove the Elizabeth Arden chemical sunscreen I was wearing (no makeup), but it had a very hard time doing so. It also started to burn while I was trying to break up the sunscreen (I do have sensitive skin, but not so sensitive that I can't use AHAs/BHAs or retinal, none of which are even in this). I got the slightest bit along my lash line of one eye (which, since it is supposed to work on eye makeup should have been okay) and not only did that burn, but it caused that area of my lash line and eyelid to turn red and swell. In fact, it still hurts to blink today, more than 16 hours and a full night's recovery after use. Other areas of my face look chemical burned as well. I don't know what ingredient(s) burned me but I wouldn't recommend this cleanser to anyone. I've never had a strong reaction like this to one and for it to be ineffective as well is just icing.
My favorite oil cleanser on the market. I have tried others and nothing lathers like this one. Peach & Lily skincare is just the best of the best!
Got this as the birthday gift, it immediately made my skin breakout
Perfect night cleanser for my routine, very hydrating, and I love the sensation

I have used and enjoyed other Peach and Lily skincare, but unfortunately this one broke me out. I gave it away to a friend and it broke her out as well. This oil cleanser is thicker than others I have used.
Product works so well for me and makes my skin feel so much cleaner
This is a very soft gentle cleanser. However it feels like extra pumps and scrubs are needed to get that clean feeling on your face

I received a bottle as one of my birthday perks from Ulta. First 3 uses, I did not think it did much. I dabbed my face with water, applied 2 pumps to my face, and rinsed it right away. Did not make any difference in removing my make up ( I use tinted sunscreen BTW). But one evening, I did my usual water dab and application of the product and was caught on doing something on my phone that it made it lingered on my face a little longer. (Safe to say more than 30 seconds). I noticed it gave out that oily texture but not in a greasy heavy way. I continued to massage the product to my face, rinsed with water. Make up removed and my skin did not feel tight or dry after rinsing. I use this as one of my double cleanser.

avis.titre: Melts Away Even the Boldest Make Up Looks
avis.texte: The Ginger Melt Oil is my go-to first step in my nightly double cleanse. I use it to dissolve make up and prep my skin for a water based cleanser. My preferences for make up range from natural to glam, with some very bold looks that include glitter and layered mascara. The Ginger Melt Cleanser dissolves it all effortlessly with no pulling or tugging. It is gentle and powerful at the same time, and one of the best cleansing oils I have ever used. It feel smooth and light on the skin, and washes off easily with no residue. This is a home run!
I've tried many cleansing oils but this one is the only one I will continue to buy. It's worth the cost for me.
Perfect oil cleanser for my two step face washing. It gets all of my makeup off and I then follow it up with the gel cleanser. My skin feels clean, calm and refreshed!

Ok, I've been using this oil cleanser for about two months. After multiple uses, I figured out what works best for me. Two pumps for the face, 1/2 to 1 pump for the eyes and brows. All my makeup (even stubborn mascara and eyeliner) is removed. One pump is not enough to remove everything, unless you're focusing on the eye area alone as I mentioned. Before applying, make sure you mix well on your fingers to distribute evenly onto your face. Give yourself at least 12-15 seconds before washing it off, especially when youre removing eye makeup. I wasn't crazy about this product at first, until I realized what I needed to do. I understand this may be too much product being used, but I don't mind it because I dont wear a lot of makeup everyday. After this step, I use the brightening cleanser by Indie Lee. I hope this helps!
I got this as my birthday gift from Ulta and had didn't have many high hopes for it. It definitely exceeded my expectations.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product agian
avis.texte: I was very hopeful this oil would remove my eye makeup easily. I found myself needing a lot of product to accomplish my needs. Removing Gen See liquid matte liquid eyeshadow.

avis.titre: The worse face wash I have ever purchased
avis.texte: This does not clean your face, does not remove makeup - it feels like I am washing my face with water. It doesn't even feel like oil, it feels like actual water.

Got this as the free bday gift. I initially liked it upon application, as it is very gentle and scent free (it would be great for sensitivw skin), but when I went in with my 2nd cleanser, there was a lot of makeup left on my face (and I wear pretty minimal makeup). Because of the poor removing power, I can't recommend this product as I like oil cleansers as my 1st step in makeup/sunscreen removal which usually does a very good job removing makeup! I can only recommend this if youre looking for a gentle face wash.

These winter months have my skin parched. I decided I was going to spoil myself and buy some new skin care products. This was one of my purchases. I bought 8 products from Peach & Lily. To my surprise 3 out of the 8 Peach & Lily items I bought were not full. At most they were 75 percent full so I returned all but this one. I have no problem spending a lot on quality products but if they are only going to half fill or fill three quarters of the way I won't waste my money. This was a disappointment to say the least. As for this product it was full. I have been using it for three weeks now. I noticed it slightly melts my makeup off, but when I get out of the shower I have mascara smeared all around my eyes. This tells me it's not doing exactly what it's supposed to. It doesn't dry out my skin or leave a greasy residue on my skin. So that right there is a plus. So I'm torn on how useful this really is... I was hoping for more.

I got the mini for the birthday gift and I was excited to try this out. But was unfortunately disappointed when I realized it took more than one cleansing to fully get rid of my mascara. I use the Sky High Maybelline mascara that is waterproof. And maybe it says more about how well the mascara holds, but it also tells me that this oil cleanser was not up for the task. It required 2-3 rounds to fully remove all the mascara from my lashes. I will say that the packaging is very sturdy and streamline. It feels very easy and smooth to get the product. I actually might use this all the way up and just put my mini Haru Haru cleansing oil in the packaging, that way I can still have access to the pump functionality. But yea besides the packaging and smooth texture, it just didn't not function as an oil cleanser that well. 3 out of 5 stars, skip this brand and go for the other korean cleansing oils. I'd suggest Haru Haru, Manyo, Althea or Iunik.

I recieved this as a birthday gift and I've always wanted to try p&l but this is a no for me. it stung my eyes and I felt like i needed to use alot of product to feel it on my face. I use another oil cleanser that takes all my eye makeup off and doesn't sting my eyes.
Love this product. Looking for a moisturizer that complements this Product. I have 71 dry skin.
I noticed the difference from the other product I was using. I'm on my 3rd bottle. I absolutely love this product. My skin is brighter and softer

Have been using this oil cleanser for over a month, but will only use 1-2 times a week and always double cleanse. It isnt very tough on makeup and some sunscreens, so I really only use it on days that i wasnt heavy on makeup and want a little extra exfoliation. It does an excellent job at removing those pesky sebum heads on my nose and i dont feel dried out after. It don't clog my pores and makes my skin so smooth. The very first couple of uses i broke out in the tiniest pimples, but as quickly as they came, they disappeared; continued use of this cleanser did not produce any more pimples. Needless to say, avoid if you like daily/semi-daily full coverage makeup or mineral sunscreen.

I got this as a birthday sample from Ulta and lets just say if it wouldn't have been free, I would be returning it. No matter how much of the product you use, it feels like you're rubbing nothing into your skin. I realize this is an oil cleanser so its different than a gel or foaming cleanser, but I still expected to feel like I had something on my face other than just water. I saw another review saying to use it on dry skin so I plan to try that, but overall I would not recommend.

avis.titre: I have purchased this again and again.
avis.texte: I use this as the first step in a two step cleansing process. I love how it melts the make up off my face. I don't feel l like can use it on my eyes, but that could just be me. It is light and refressing.

I got this as a free gift for my birthday. I love this clean line of Peach and Lily. This is terrible on your face. It feels gross laying onto of your skin. It does nothing to clean face. Jesus loves you.
Love this cleansing oil! Some cleansing oils really thin and i feel like dont get as much out of my skin. this cleansing oil is phenomenal and i've purchased many bottles of this.

I really appreciate how light this is. I accidentally got even got a little bit in my mouth and It wasn't that bad lol. My only issue is I continue to have a hard time getting my (non-waterproof) eye makeup off with this and I'll look like a raccoon even when I was sure I got my eyes. It's great when I don't wear eye makeup.
I started with this in 2024 and never went back to my old oil cleanser! This one is a good price point for its size and if you conserve it well enough, it lasts very long.
I love how it makes my skin feels, and it's not drying and doesn't make my skin oily
I'm in love with this oil cleanser! I've used a few others by other companies but this one hands down is my favorite!

I love this product. It says oil, but it's not oily. I apply it with a little water and it really does the job cleansing my face without drying it. It's one of the best facial cleanser I've come across and intend to keep using.

I am impressed with this cleanser, and the product does prove to be efficient. It works best if applied to a dry face/chest, and for the full effect, worked into the skin for several minutes before rinsing. I've noticed that the pores around my chin area have finally cleared after I started using this product, and I've tried multiple other "remedies" before settling on this oil cleanser. I do recommend purchasing to anyone with stubborn pores.
This feels so good it makes me happy to use it. It makes my face feel so clean and it feels so elevated. Love it!
I have repurchased this oil cleanser several times. This does not burn my eyes and successfully melts my makeup off.

Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser is a perfect first cleanse if you double cleanse. It removes all makeup and rinses off well, preparing your skin for the next step in your routine. I double cleanse, so I follow with a water based cleanser. The combination leaves my skin clean and soft, not tight or dry. This is my second purchase of this item.
This is a nice and smooth oil cleanser. It melts the yuck away and leaves my skin fresh feeling but not stripped of moisture. It's economical too. A little goes a long way. Try it, you might like it!
Does a wonderful job removing all my make-up without stripping my face leaves it soft and hydrated.

I LOVE THIS. This is the first step in my routine. I double cleanse and honestly if I'm feeling lazy or if my skin is very dry (I have combination skin), I'll use this by itself to avoid stripping more moisture from my skin barrier. This is a double cleanse product MUST HAVE! Double cleanse products, 10/10

avis.titre: This is my ride or die, a
avis.texte: This is my ride or die, and I couldn't imagine not having it!

avis.titre: So far I have enjoyed all
avis.texte: So far I have enjoyed all of my new products! The eye serum from Peach Slices has already had such a lovely effect, and the azelaic acid has visibly reduced my redness in only a few days of regular use.

avis.titre: Irritates sensitive skin but great for oily skin
avis.texte: This one irritates my sensitive skin but it is great for my boyfriend's oily skin. Gets sunscreen off easily. For the large bottle because he uses it everyday.

This cleanser is so great in combination with the power bubble cleanser. It is excellent at removing makeup, and getting skin nice and clean. It is gentle and has very little scent if that is something you are sensitive to! It's a great start to the routine. My boyfriend has started stealing little samples of it!
I like the cleansing attributes of this cleanser. This is one of the first oil cleansers that I have tried. I feel like it does work well in making my face feel smooth and glowing.
very soft and soothing cleanser. as long as your skin barrier isn't shot it works great. this face oil advertising make up removing is very false. I wouldn't recommend if thats why your buying it.

I love most Peach & Lily products I've tried except this one. IT DID NOT REMOVE ANY OF MY MAKEUP AT ALL. It smudged my makeup all around my face. Irritated my sensitive skin because I had to wash my face a second time with a different cleanser. Very disappointing and confusing as to how this product hasn't been pulled off shelves.

I normally LOVE P&L products but this one was a miss for me. It is more of a gel than oil cleanser. I had to be VERY careful when using on my eyes or it would burn. I have very sensitive skin/eyes. Will not repurchase. I prefer Curel makeup cleansing oil.

Absolutely love this product. Highly recommend. Leaves my skin beautifully intact and flawless. I would say within the first 2 weeks I saw a MAJOR difference than with my other super high end products. Tried other products but I always come back to this one.
i have extreme allergies, especially around the eyes. This is gentle enough for my sensitivities but wipes away leftover products like its nothing. excellent product

i really enjoy this cleanser for removing my makeup, it takes off my waterproof mascara and other makeup really easily, and i like that it's a little lighter than using a balm. I always double cleanse after using makeup removers but this cleanser is easily removable on its own and doesn't leave any residue on my face! it also has many great attributes that help moisturize the skin added into the formula.
claims to remove but i was highly disappointed to get out the showerand still see smudged makeup. it is also not moosturizing i had dry patches on my skin after.
Good product for getting off sunscreen but I believe it's a bit overpriced.

This early fall, I purchased Peach and Lily Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser. Unlike other cleansers that comes out as a lotion, this has a oily touch to spread on your face with a cotton pad or ball, or a finger. It does has a nice smell that's not overwhelming and gentle for your skin and senses. With a simple spritz from the spray bottle nozzle, it takes everything off and leaves a refreshed smell on your skin.
Love this for removing makeup. Doesn't bother my eyes. I first used it with water by accident,,, you are supposed to use it alone(dry) without water. Amazing product.
I tried this being very skeptical…I wasn't expecting much, but I've been using this for 2 weeks. My skin feels so clean and soft. I love it!!
One or two pumps with some water melts all makeup for thorough wash. All good!
This has been my facial cleanser since it hit the Peach and Lily website. It's very gentle and doesn't cause breakouts.
Gentle and hydrating. I very much the way it makes my skin feel. Good stuff.
It did not remove my foundation makeup. I dont even use face primer to make it stay. I had to follow up with their gel cleanse twice to fully take off my foundation and blush make up.

While I don't have oily skin, this has helped clean and clear up the areas around my nose. It helps to pull out the dirt and small number of oils in my pores. This is the first think I use to start my routine every morning and night. Love this product.

avis.titre: I'll Be Buying This Cleanser Again and Again!
avis.texte: I am loving the glass skin line from PEACH & LILY! This cleanser is a must for me; I use it once per day in the P.M. I am a person who does not wear makeup ever day; however, I still find that using this cleanser before my Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser really prepares my skin for the rest of my skincare products. I enjoy the fact that it is a thicker consistency, and that it is effective, yet gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Not worth it/does NOT remove any makeup
avis.texte: Used it once and already debating if i should return it, it didn't even remove lipstick let alone the rest of my makeup, so how am I supposed to believe its removing anything else like dirt from my skin? It also burned my eyes and made then feel raw

I especially enjoy the larger bottle. THANK YOU! The fact that this product's consistency is thick and a little goes a long way means so much to my budget. It helps me feel secure that my face is thoroughly cleansed from the day's stressors, making it perfect as a starter to my evening routine.
This is one of the best oil cleansers I've ever used. It smells delightful without being overpowering, and evicerates any left over makeup my wipe missed
This is my favorite makeup remover. It takes everything off, even waterproof makeup. Followed by the power calm hydrating cleanser it's an unstoppable duo. Not drying or stripping.
2nd time purchasing and I love it! Works very well and even helps remove makeup!
Helps remove makeup easily. I normally have sensitive skin and had no problems adding this product into my facial routine.

avis.titre: By Far the Best Oil Cleanser I've Tried
avis.texte: Love everything about this oil cleanser. I have combination skin and this does not make me oiler. It also does not cause me to break out. I'd purchase again and again.

avis.titre: Amazing product that changed my skin
avis.texte: My face has been clear, glowing, and soft since I started using the oil cleanser. It's unscented, glides on my face nicely and removes the deep oil in my pores. I recommend using the oil cleanser, then the power, calm, hydrating gel, cleanser, and then the amazing glass skin face polisher.
Highly recommend, I've gone through multiple of these and will continue to buy!
I used this every night to remove my daytime lotion, sunscreen, and make up. And it also works great with waterproof mascara like those japanese brand that's really hard to remove. Great product
I love this cleanser. It is gentle and hydrating. My skin feels so good after using it. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Hands down the best oil cleanser
avis.texte: There's nothing like it, the best oil cleanser ever!! Both my boyfriend and I are onto our second bottles. I love the texture, ingredients and it just gets the job done. I pair mine with the P&L hydrobubble foam cleanser, which is also a new fave.

avis.titre: My face has never felt so good!
avis.texte: I only contribute reviews when a product is either amazing or horribly bad. By accident I did a double cleanse using this Ginger Melt Oil Cleanser followed by CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser (green label). My face has never felt so soft, smooth, or clean. This combo is now my must-do every morning to wake up and I look forward to washing my face every morning.

I absolutely love this stuff. It is not harsh like makeup, wipe removers or it gets all of my foundation off, but it doesn't get all of the mascara off right away. I love the way it makes my skin feel after

A staple in my skincare routine. I use this to double cleanse at night--regardless if I've worn makeup, but it is SO good at removing WATERPROOF makeup. Your eyes, face, neck, chest, everything. It is so soothing, too, and very gentle.

This works to clean makeup off, but it shouldn't be used without a second oil-free cleanser. My face isn't a huge fan & may cause acne but the bottle has lasted me forever because I don't wear a lot of makeup. For the price of this, I would suggest buying a more affordable oil based cleaser for makeup. I don't feel that it is worth the price. Feels too heavy as well.
My fave cleansing oil ever. Lightweight yet can easily take off all my makeup
This is easily the best brand I've ever used, my skin is always so soft and calm, even before I have my period. I'll never use anything else!
I purchased this soo many times now and I completely love it, it feels so nice on my face and its not to heavy or greasy and its a important part of my double cleansing routine

This is my second jumbo bottle. Best oil cleanser I've tried so far. I have very sensitive skin and this is perfect for me. This cleanser even takes my mascara off at night. This has become my new staple in my nighttime routine.

I can't believe how long I used make-up wipes when I could have been using this oil cleanser. It is an incredible product- truly. I'm a professional dancer and after performances my make-up literally melts right off. It has completely changed my skincare game. It is super hydrating and soothing on the skin. I love this for a double cleanse because standard face washes tend to dry my skin out. No other oil cleaners or make-up removers have ever beat out this one!
Can be used as a gentle face cleanser but not good for taking off all makeup and sunscreen.
Have repurchased 3 times, my favorite oil cleanser! Gets everything off and doesn't bother my sensitive skin
Didn't think id love this as much as I do! This takes off all traces of makeup and leaves my skin feeling so soft
This cleanser is a home run. Combined with the water-based cleanser, it is the perfect duo for deep cleaning. It takes off ALL my makeup without any dryness or irritation. LOVE
Love Peach and Lily products. I recommend them to so many people!!

This cleanser has worked WONDERS for my skin. I use it in conjunction with the cleanser and I feel like my acne has improved so much. My hyper pigmentation has also gone down a ton. Cleans my face without feeling yucky, I let my mom try the trial size and it's a huge hit!!! ABSOLUTE necessity for acne prone skin!
I'm always stocked up on this product. If I don't use it, my pores clog up. It's most definitely my step 1 to skincare!
I love that the fragrance isn't over whelming and it cleans so well!
I helps to gently remove my hard to get off mascara and makeup at the end of a long day. It leaves my skin soft but clean. I follow up with the gel cleaner and they are the perfect combo!

I've never used an oil cleanser so I was a bit skeptical, but I love how my skin feels & looks! It doesn't get all of my makeup off, so I paired it with the foam cleanser. I use the oil cleanser every morning and the foam cleanser every evening; it's perfect combo!

Still debating how I feel about this cleanser. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and am just not sure about it. The consistency is pretty watery which makes me feel the need use more to ensure I'm covering my entire face and really pulling out that excess sebum. So far I've not been super impressed. I will definitely continue to give it more time. I'm a licensed esthetician and have heard influencers raving about this product for quite some time but sofar I am not sold as to why.
